# Cal/OSHA Active Shooter and Workplace Violence Awareness Training

> 1-hour online awareness course for California employees covering the four types of workplace violence, warning signs, reporting without reprisal, and active shooter response (Run, Hide, Fight). Supports California Labor Code Section 6401.9 (SB 553) training requirements and Title 8 CCR Section 3220 (Emergency Action Plan), supplemented by DHS and CISA active shooter preparedness guidance. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Law and standards: California Labor Code §6401.9 (SB 553); Title 8 CCR §3220
- Training timing: when the WVPP is established, annually, and when the plan changes or a new hazard is identified
- Records: violent incident logs, hazard and investigation records kept 5 years; training records kept 1 year
- Duration: about 1 hour; 3 lessons plus final exam
- Credits: 0.1 CEU
- Price: $49.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats; SCORM, virtual and in-person options
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; English and Spanish
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months
- Prerequisites: none

## Four types of workplace violence (California law)
1. Criminal intent (no legitimate business at the worksite)
2. Customer/client
3. Worker-on-worker
4. Personal relationship

## Who it is for
All employees covered by a WVPP (full-time, part-time, temporary, seasonal); supervisors and managers; HR, safety and security staff; public-facing and higher-risk roles (retail, hospitality, banking, transit, education, government, utilities, late-night and cash-handling work); exempt employers who still want staff prepared.

## Lessons
1. Understanding Workplace Violence
2. Prevention, Response, and Emergency Preparedness (including Run, Hide, Fight)
3. Workplace Violence Prevention Program
